tax_name: Porez na dodatu vrednost (PDV) / Порез на додату вредност
legal_ref: Закон о порезу на додату вредност (Сл. гласник РС 84/2004 ... 80/2026), чл. 23 ст. 1 (rate per amendment Сл. гласник РС 93/2012)
quote: Општа стопа ПДВ за опорезиви промет добара и услуга или увоз добара износи 20%. [fn: Службени гласник РС, број 93/2012] — The general VAT rate on taxable supplies of goods and services or imports is 20%.
source_title: Министарство финансија РС — Закон о порезу на додату вредност, пречишћен текст (incl. Сл. гласник РС 80/2026); cross-checked Пореска управа 'Опште о ПДВ' (https://www.purs.gov.rs/pravna-lica/pdv/opste-o-pdv.html): 'Општа стопа 20% Посебна стопа 10% (чл. 23)'

reduced_rates.scope: special rate (Art. 23 para 2, rate per 108/2013): bread, milk, flour, sugar, edible oils, fresh fruit/veg/meat/fish/eggs, medicines, medical implants, fertilisers/seeds/feed, textbooks, daily newspapers, firewood/pellets, hotel accommodation, admission tickets (cinema, theatre, concerts, sports, museums), natural gas, district heating, first transfer of residential buildings, drinking water, waste water, municipal waste, passenger transport, funeral services
exemptions with right of input deduction (Art. 24): exports, international transport, free zones etc.

notes: Amending law Сл. гласник РС 80/2026 (in force 8 Sept 2026, mostly applicable from 1 Jan 2027) does not change Art. 23 rates. Registration: mandatory once turnover in previous 12 months exceeds RSD 8,000,000 (Art. 38); small taxpayer threshold RSD 8,000,000 (Art. 33).
unverified: valid_from 2012-10-01: the 20% rate is footnoted to Сл. гласник РС 93/2012 in the official consolidated text, but the application date 1 Oct 2012 (transitional provision of 93/2012) was confirmed only via KPMG Serbia tax news (Oct 2012)
